gpu_tip: ~22GB total at 128K context. An 8GB GPU (e.g. RTX 4060 Ti) plus a 24GB DDR5 kit covers it — llama.cpp splits this dense model layer-by-layer between GPU and CPU, so even the BF16 build doesn't need a workstation card.
mac_tip: Needs ~22GB — fits a 24GB MacBook Pro (M4, M4 Pro, M5, or M5 Pro) comfortably.
